# Length-`0x28` motion research fixtures

Generated by `tools/gen_motion40_fixture.py` from genuine Pro Controller 2
captures. Nothing in the firmware or the host suite includes these headers:
synthesized translated length-`0x28` motion was rejected on hardware and is
deferred (`docs/agents/MOTION.md`, `docs/experiments/refuted-hypotheses.md`).

They lived in `contracts/` until 2026-11-10. That directory is for wire
contracts shared by firmware, companions and tests; these are research data,
kept so the work can be resumed without recapturing.
